answer: A forger does not fear a form, only a price, so put new identities up for auction. Each epoch auctions just 100 identity slots, with every bid public on the ledger for any peer to check. A winner pays the clearing price and waits one full epoch before it may answer. One wallet caught backing two slots loses both slots and both payments. Buying 10,000 fakes at 15 POA each costs 150,000 POA and takes 100 epochs, about 25 days, before the army exists. A summit is not opened by a sonnet, and an orchard auctioning a hundred baskets a season keeps its fruit because every basket has a buyer.
